title: We launched Void Idle today - a browser idle MMO built with AI assistance. 200+ concurrent players in the first 7 hours.
author: Stylsviqzzzz
selftext:
We just launched **Void Idle**, a browser-based idle/incremental RPG, after \~6 months of closed testing with our community. Seven hours in we're at **200+ concurrent players** — way past what we expected for day one.

Quick rundown of what it is:

* Idle combat across 12+ zones — fight, level up, loot, and enhance gear
* Per-weapon ability trees, gathering & crafting, guilds, a player-driven marketplace and shops, world bosses, and parties
* Full offline progression, so it keeps going while you're away
* Runs in the browser, playable on mobile

It was built with **AI assistance** (Claude Code), but human-led on all the design, architecture, and balance calls, happy to get into the workflow in the comments if anyone's curious.

Would love feedback from this community

👉 **Play it here:** [**voididle.com**](http://voididle.com)
